params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Jarvan IV}} basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to a portion of the {{as|target's '''current''' health}}.
params.blurb2: This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Jarvan IV's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|8% of the target's '''current''' health}}, with a minimum threshold of 20 and capped at 400 against non-{{tip|champion}} targets.
params.description2: This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.
params.notes:
* ''Martial Cadence's'' damage is based on the current health of the target before any damage of the attack has been dealt.
* ''Martial Cadence's'' damage is dealt after the main attack damage.
** If the target dies to the main attack damage, the additional damage will not be dealt.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jarvan IV}} extends his lance in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{sti|lethality|{{as|reducing their armor|armor}}}} for a short time.
params.blurb2: If the lance connects with a deployed ''{{ai|Demacian Standard|Jarvan IV}}'', he will {{tip|dash}} to its location, {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} enemies he passes by.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jarvan IV''' extends his lance in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and inflicting them with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}} for 3 seconds.
params.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|90 to 250}} {{as|(+ 145% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}{{st|Armor Reduction|{{as|{{ap|10 to 26}}% of target's armor}}}}
params.description2: If the lance connects with a deployed ''{{ai|Demacian Standard|Jarvan IV}}'', '''Jarvan IV''' {{tip|dashes}} to its location, {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} nearby enemies around him and along his path for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
params.description3: '''''Jarvan IV''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''
params.range: {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|65 – 785|Minimum and maximum area & dash range}}|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|0 – 850|Flag detection minimum and maximum distance}}}}
params.width: {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|136|Damage area width}}|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|300|Flag detection width}}}}
params.notes:
* The armor reduction is applied after the damage. The damage dealt does not benefit from it in this case.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* ''Dragon Strike'' will still pull '''Jarvan IV''' to {{ai|Demacian Standard|Jarvan IV}} even if he is {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}.
* {{si|Flash}} will interrupt the {{tip|dash}} to a {{ai|Demacian Standard|Jarvan IV}} but '''Jarvan IV''' will still {{tip|airborne|knock up}} at the new location.
** Casting ''Flash'' right before the ''dash'' begins will cause '''Jarvan IV''' to be pulled to the flag from the new position.
** Enemies already hit by ''Dragon Strike'' cannot be affected more than once.
* The {{tip|airborne|knockup}} also slightly moves the target, landing 50–100 units in a random direction.
* If ''Dragon Strike'' hits multiple ''{{ai|Demacian Standard|Jarvan IV|Demacian Standards}}'' in the range, it will pull '''Jarvan IV''' to the one furthest from his position.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jarvan IV}} {{tip|slow|slows}} nearby enemies for a short time.
params.blurb2: He will also {{tip|shield}} himself for a few seconds, with the strength increased if he hit more enemy {{tip|champions}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jarvan IV''' {{tip|slow|slows}} all nearby enemies for 2 seconds.
params.description2: '''Jarvan IV''' also grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for 4 seconds, increased by {{as|{{fd|1.3}}% of his '''maximum''' health}} for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit by ''Golden Aegis''.
params.notes:
* ''Golden Aegis''  deals no damage and thus does '''not''' trigger {{tip|turret}} aggro, or effects such as {{ii|Elixir of Sorcery}} and {{ris|Sudden Impact}} activation.
* ''Golden Aegis'' will activate [[combat status]] despite not dealing any damage.

params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jarvan IV''' plants a flag at the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.blurb3: The flag lingers for a period, emitting an {{tip|aura}} that grants {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} to '''Jarvan''' and allied champions.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jarvan IV''' throws a Demacian flag to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within the area.
params.description3: The flag then remains for 8 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings and providing an {{tip|aura}} that grants ''Demacian Standard's'' passive {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} to all nearby allied champions as well as '''Jarvan IV''' {{tt|himself|See notes}}.
params.notes:
* The attack speed granted from a deployed ''Demacian Standard'' {{tip|stacks additively}} with ''Demacian Standard's'' passive permanent bonus attack speed to '''Jarvan IV''', but the aura from multiple ''Demacian Standards'' does not stack.
** '''Jarvan IV''' gains a total of {{ap|20*2 to 30*2}}% bonus attack speed from ''Demacian Standard'' while near the flag.
* The flag has a {{fd|13.6}} {{tip|pathing radius}} and a 65 {{tip|gameplay radius}}.
** The gameplay radius matters to {{ai|Dragon Strike|Jarvan IV}}.
* ''Demacian Standard'' can be targeted by allied abilities ({{si|Teleport}}, {{ai|Safeguard|Lee Sin}}). The target type is the same as a {{tip|minion}}.
* ''Demacian Standard'' is {{tip|untargetable}} to enemies.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jarvan IV}} {{tip|dash|leaps}} {{tip|displacement immune|Unstoppably}} to the target enemy champion's location, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies upon impact.
params.blurb2: He then erects a circle of [[terrain]] that lasts for a short time.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jarvan IV''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target enemy champion's location over {{fd|0.35}} seconds, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all nearby enemies upon arrival.
params.description2: Upon impact, he creates a circle of impassable terrain that {{tip|airborne|knocks aside}} enemies within the perimeter over {{fd|0.15}} seconds, knocking them out of the circle if they are on the outer edge and pulling them in otherwise. The terrain lasts for {{fd|3.5}} seconds and grants {{tip|sight}} of the area. ''Cataclysm'' can be recast after {{fd|0.75}} seconds while the terrain is present.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Jarvan IV''' destroys the terrain created by ''Cataclysm''.
params.speed: {{tt|Distance to target{{Divided by}}{{fd|0.35}} s|Dash speed varies based on cast distance}}
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tt|350|Terrain creation radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly = true}}{{tt|1700|Sight range (from center of the whole structure)}}}}
params.notes:
* The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
** If the ability is not manually recasted, the secondary effect will trigger without being considered as an ability activation.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the damage but not the terrain generation.
* If '''Jarvan IV's''' {{tip|dash|leap}} is interrupted by another by another forced movement (eg. old {{cai|Impale old2|Skarner|variant=old|Impale}}<ref>[https://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/njwmqn/skarners_ultimate_ignores_unstoppability/ Jarvan IV R vs old Skarner R]</ref>), the terrain will be generated at '''Jarvan IV's''' location when the forced movement ends.<!--there could be other examples like bugged infernal rift blast cone-->
* ''Cataclysm'' will not deal damage, generate terrain, nor refund its cooldown if '''Jarvan IV''' is killed while leaping.
* The perimeter is made up of 24 units with 95 {{tip|pathing radius}}, 65 {{tip|gameplay radius}} and 1350 {{tip|sight}} radius each. Only every other unit is rendered visible.
* {{cai|Searing Charge|Ornn}} will not destroy the whole ring but only the part that {{ci|Ornn}} collides with.
